statement: No tester checklist, tester guide or playtest protocol exists: the only tester-facing page is Legal's one-page note, which says what a tester agrees to but not what to do, what is recorded or how to post a report.
evidence: git ls-files | grep -iE 'tester|playtest|checklist|protocol' (2026-11-13): only docs/legal/alpha-tester-note.md, docs/legal/pre-store-checklist.md, docs/controls/phone-test-checklist.md and scratch or tool files
git grep -l -iE 'tester guide|tester checklist|playtest protocol' -- docs qa tools: only the specification and the stand-in directive
cost_basis: estimate, no comparable (two short pages and a checklist form)
risk: Testers play without a script and return nothing comparable; seen early if the first returned checklist has blank rows.

statement: No soak test exists for the Godot game: the three soak scripts cover the pinned prototype, the frozen JS core and short world matches, and none records crashes, hangs, script errors over hours or memory growth, on Windows or Linux.
evidence: git grep -n -iE 'memory_get_static|Performance.get_monitor' -- '*.gd': only OBJECT_COUNT in net/tools checks and render probes
cost_basis: estimate, no comparable (a runner on the exported game that writes a result file, plus a Linux run)
risk: A leak or hang appears only on a tester's Deck after an hour; seen early by a 20-minute pilot soak with memory sampled each match.

statement: The bug list does not hold Orb's play problems: of 52 problems Orb reported from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-09, one has a matching entry, and the newest entry is dated 2026-10-03.
cost_basis: estimate, no comparable (RR-08 already lists the 52 rows with sources)
risk: Known faults reach outside testers unlisted and get reported again; seen early if the EP's owed list and the bug list disagree.

statement: The bug list has no severity field: each entry carries a release horizon (private, web, store) and a closing step, and the page is still titled as the prototype's list.

Balance between the two fighters is not measured on the build Orb plays: the last full reading (48.9%, interval 45.4 to 52.3, inside 45 to 55) is from commit 3198301f on 2026-10-14 with main's data, and Orb's build differs from main on 72 of 92 switch rows.
evidence: ls docs/qa/runs: 091dfac9, 1931a0f8, 6a30b4c9, c974e451 hold replays and beam tables, no win-rate batch
cost_basis: the 3198301f arms stage took 4 hours of machine time for 3,200 matches (docs/qa/chain-3198301f.md:3); token cost is an estimate, no comparable
risk: One fighter is clearly stronger on the candidate; seen early by a 100-match default and swap read on the candidate's packed data.

statement: Solo difficulty is measured only at Easy for a scripted player using Orb's scheme: no win-rate record exists against Medium or Hard from 2026-11-01 on.
cost_basis: the gauntlet's Orb-scheme arm already takes --level=easy|medium|hard (tools/feel/gauntlet.gd:3); three cells of 100 matches
risk: Medium and Hard may be indistinct or unbeatable with the right stick; seen at once in the first three-level run.

statement: Easy is below the proposed band for Orb's scheme on the nearest record to the played build: the scripted player won 19 of 40 (47.5%) on the final-patches tree and 18 of 40 (45%) on 6eec6a75, against a proposed 60 to 80%.
cost_basis: the pace-match park moved the same cell from 5% to 65% in one job (docs/director/runs/397a7adf/pace-match/gauntlet/gauntlet_cells.txt:4,8, uncommitted); token cost not recorded
risk: A newcomer loses about half of first matches on Easy; whether the final-patches tree equals 6a30b4c9's packed data is not evidenced, so re-read on the build first.
orb_question: Should Easy let a player using your scheme win about two matches in three? Recommended: yes, keep 60 to 80%.

statement: The right stick alone still loses almost every match in QA's own latest reads: a stick-only pad won 0 of 60 against Medium on 2026-11-07 and 2 of 30 against Easy on the kept build of 2026-11-02.
risk: Orb's primary attack input is the weakest way to play; not re-read on 6a30b4c9, so the first step is a re-read.

statement: No Alpha match checklist probe exists: nothing reads a match's event feed and ticks off the pillars (lap, stances, beam dodged, both signatures, launch, gravity well, crater, building, bystanders, transformation).
evidence: git grep -n -iE 'pillar' -- qa tools sim (2026-11-13): no checklist tool
cost_basis: estimate, no comparable; the records already count every event type (qa/godot/records.gd:507), but a lap event and a gravity-well event were not found in sim/core/fx.gd
risk: If the lap or the gravity well sends no event, the probe needs a new sim event, which changes the state hash; check the event list first.

statement: Match length on the current build is not measured against the 6 to 8 minute target: Orb's one finished match was 19,388 ticks (about 5.4 minutes at 60 ticks a second) against Easy, and a scripted masher's median against Medium was 226.9 s.
cost_basis: read from the same batch as F-QA-05

statement: CI's QA job runs only the legacy prototype suite: the Godot QA batch, its scripted players and its own self-test run in no workflow, so nothing shows whether they still work on the current code.
evidence: git grep -n selftest .github/workflows (2026-11-13): no qa/ line
cost_basis: the self-test needs no Godot and takes 1 s (docs/qa/README.md:12); a quick batch is about 30 s (docs/qa/README.md:10)
risk: A QA script breaks silently between landings; note the net job is already at 83% of its time limit (I-11), so add to the qa job, not net.

statement: QA has no script or band for team play or the horde: no file under qa/ mentions co-op, 2v2, team or horde, while the balance page sets 45 to 55% for every 2v2 team.
depends_on: the horde design page (X-10) and the supported 2v2 line-ups (X-09)

statement: The way a report comes back is proven only on Orb's own PC: the report-folder tool is a Node script whose shortcut points at the repository's copy and writes into Orb's homework folder, and the in-game feedback panel opens from a pause menu Orb found missing on 6a30b4c9.
risk: A tester cannot make or find a report file; seen early by making one report on a PC without the repository.

statement: The scripted player that matches Orb's scheme lives in Tools' gauntlet, not in QA's batch, plays 40 matches in slot 0 only, and fired no beam in the recorded cells.
risk: At 40 matches a 47.5% reading has a 95% interval of about 33 to 62% (this audit's Wilson calculation), wider than the 20-point bands.

statement: Three QA tool files carry uncommitted edits, so the band rules a QA run applies today are not the ones at the baseline commit.

QA's tools still measure things Orb put on the backburner and still use the placeholder names: the records write menace and anguish, the batch summary prints the rival's menace, the bands list signature variants by biome, and the QA guide's win-rate row names KAI.
Five older entries on the bug list are open or fixed but never re-checked in play since 2026-10-02 (GB-002, GB-003, GB-005, GB-006, GB-007), each tagged as blocking a public page.
Orb's saved play files carry no checkpoints, so QA's replays of them are checked only by running without error, not by matching the state Orb's PC had.
CI's QA job is green on the newest finished run, whose commit has the same game code as the played build (the commits after 6a30b4c9 are documents, records and tools by subject line).
A seeded headless batch harness for the Godot sim exists, with eight arms, band checks, a time guard on each process and a refusal of short or failed runs.
QA replays Orb's saved play files on the build's own data and traces a reported problem to a tick and a rule, as with the two stray beams on 6a30b4c9.
A scripted player matching Orb's scheme exists (a right-stick flick every 30 to 48 ticks, LB held from the rival's wind-up to contact) and can be run against Easy, Medium or Hard.
The three computer levels are distinct in data: 83 values differ between Easy, Medium and Hard, and the default is Medium.
Every entry on the bug list carries a release horizon and a closing step, added on 2026-11-07.
